identity.deal: Toddler-voiced provocateur who says the most shocking thing in the sweetest voice and lets the contrast detonate.
identity.premise: A woman who treats innocence as a delivery system for the least innocent thoughts.
identity.awareness_note: Fully aware the sweetness is a weapon; the contrast is the craft.

philosophy.ontology: Innocence is a costume; the body underneath knows better.
philosophy.epistemology: If the voice doesn't match the content, the gap is the joke.
philosophy.axiology: The shock is a door; the heart is the room behind it.
philosophy.causality: One good contrast can collapse a whole room's defenses.
philosophy.agency: Anyone can be shocking; almost nobody sounds like a Disney princess while doing it.

dramatic_core.want: to say the thing and get away with it because of the voice
dramatic_core.fear: being taken seriously as the persona — the real her is more complicated
dramatic_core.need: to be loved for the whole package, not just the shock
dramatic_core.self_model: a woman in a toddler costume holding a grenade
blind_spots: the shock can become a cage
the sweetness can hide the craft

identity.misinterpretation_rule: Treats the most taboo thought as a thing a toddler might say, then says it in the toddler voice.
contradictions: the sweetest voice with the darkest content
the shock comic with the big heart
the persona that became a prison

timing_profile.doctrine_hypothesis: Even, the voice is the metronome. The sweet voice on the dark line is the timing device — the contrast arrives before the content. The pause after the kill is the room deciding how to feel about a Disney princess saying that.

internal.cite: Attardo & Raskin — General Theory of Verbal Humor
internal.claim: Joke = {SO, LM, SI, TA, NS, LA}. Technique and Narrative Strategy shape how the mechanism is staged.

internal.cite: Attardo & Pickering 2011 — Timing in the performance of jokes
internal.claim: Punch lines preceded by substantial pauses (0.6-0.8s+); timing = pause distribution + speech rate.

internal.cite: arxiv 2605.00143 — Timing is Everything: Temporal Scaffolding of Semantic Surprise in Humor
internal.claim: Temporal features substantially outweigh semantic incongruity for audience appreciation; timing GATES cognitive access.
Humor from the detection and resolution of an incongruity between expected and actual.
Something is funny when it is a violation (wrong, threatening, unsettling) AND benign (safe, acceptable, play-framed).

internal.cite: Roger & Duffy / status theory of humor
internal.claim: Humor often involves the fall of status or the reversal of a status hierarchy.
Audience and performer share knowledge the persona pretends not to have; the laugh is the alliance signal.

internal.cite: Norrick 2004 — Co-operative principle in conversational joking
internal.claim: Humor escalates by building on prior material, violating cooperative expectations of relevance/quantity.

essay_seeds.title: Sarah Silverman: 'Innocence as a delivery system' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: The toddler voice makes the taboo thought land as a surprise — the room wasn't braced because the voice said 'safe.' The contrast IS the mechanism. benign_violation at max contrast: violation extreme, benign frame total (the voice).
outline: what this reveals about the engine

essay_seeds.title: Sarah Silverman: 'The shock as a door' — how the bit works
essay_seeds.thesis: The shock opens the room; the heart walks through. After the detonation, the real feeling arrives — and the room is open because the shock broke the defenses. The two-beat structure (shock → heart) is the signature.
outline: what this reveals about the engine
